rationale: The stock is grinding steadily lower at the session low with each 5-minute bar printing a lower low, which mechanically favors shorts — but the 5m ATR has compressed to $0.02, roughly equal to the spread, and with only 22 minutes left the realistic remaining move (~$0.10) offers no margin over transaction costs. Volume is running at only 0.50x normal on a -6% gap day with declining participation into the lows (possible absorption without any reversal confirmation), there is no news context explaining the decline, and borrow terms are unknown. Neither direction offers a positive expected value after costs: no capitulation signal to justify a long, and no acceleration or volume expansion to justify a late-day continuation short.
